name: Munoth Financial Services Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1990, Munoth Financial Services Ltd is a part of Munoth Group and is engaged in capital market business
keyPoints:
Services Offered:
a) Depository participant:[1]
Provides facilities to institutional and retail investors to maintain their investments in securities in electronic form
b) Stock Broking:[2]
Company provides institutional broking business and is empanelled with several public sector banks and insurance companies
c) Merchant Banking:[3]
Provides valuation services viz. Issue Management, M&A, Investment banking, Advisory Services, Re-structuring, Esops, etc.
d) Portfolio Management Services:[4]
Idea generation, Stock research, Portfolio construction, Portfolio management

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 4.38% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of -1.26% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 621 days.
